Task manages reusable task definitions, stored in this host's database.

Tasks exist independently of agents: several agents can be spawned with the
same task ("agent spawn <name> --task <task>" sends its content as the
agent's first message).

Usage:
  agent task [flags]
  agent task [command]

Examples:
  agent task set review-auth -f tasks/review-auth.md
  agent spawn reviewer --backend claude --task review-auth

Available Commands:
  set         Create or update a task
  get         Print a task's content
  list        List all tasks
  clear       Remove a task

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for task

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent task [command] --help" for more information about a command.
